title: Broadcasting: Television
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: BROADCASTING: STREAMING AND TELEVISION Certificate of Achievement (CA) (Program Code 060420, State Code 21889)
outcomes: Students will write broadcast copy for audio and video, including news, sports, entertainment, promos, commercials, and public service announcements with emphasis on video production.
Students will identify and apply theory and practice to create radio, podcasting, and television programs with emphasis on video production.
Students will demonstrate producing, programming, and hosting skills within a studio, radio station, or television station structure with emphasis on video production.

notes: The catalog has no section titled 'Broadcasting: Television'; the 2026-2027 catalog prints 'Broadcasting: Streaming and Television' Certificate of Achievement (State Code 21889), whose eight required courses match the closed list exactly. Read as the same program, apparently renamed.

Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (BRDCSTG 001) and some new titles (e.g., BRDCSTG 023 'Live Streaming Production' vs. state 'News, Sports, and Live Remote Broadcasting'; BRDCSTG 046 'Fundamentals of Broadcast Studio Production'); matched to closed-list codes by number.
Total: 25 printed for the certificate; required courses sum to 25.
The page also prints the A.A. degree of the same name (32 major units, adds BRDCSTG 025 and 047) and other Broadcasting awards; these were not used.
No careers are named in this certificate's section; 'careers in radio, TV, and voice-over' appears only in the Performance certificate section.
